purpose: Valid buyer x frequency x units-per-occasion case with a defined eligible population and window.
convention: volume = population x penetration x occasions per buyer x units per occasion; Shapley attribution.
derivation: Penetration 5% -> 5.5%; frequency 4.0 -> 3.8; units per occasion 1.5 -> 1.5; population constant. Volume 6000 -> 6270 (+270). With population and units/occasion unchanged (K = 20000 x 1.5 = 30000), two-factor Shapley: penetration effect = K x 0.005 x (4.0 + 3.8)/2 = 585; frequency effect = K x (-0.2) x (0.05 + 0.055)/2 = -315. 585 - 315 = 270.
edge_case_expectation: Penetration growth offset by lower purchase frequency must both be visible.
